rules.text: GET /api/brandsList returns one entry per catalogue product: the entry id is the product id and brand is that product's brand. A brand appears once per product it has; the distinct brand names are our brands.
The public catalogue API, brandsList included, always answers with HTTP status 200 and reports the outcome in the responseCode field of its JSON body.
In the Brands panel of the Products page sidebar, each brand links to a page listing that brand's products.
Contact Us form: Email is mandatory (red asterisk); Name, Subject and Message are optional. The form must not be sent while a mandatory field is empty or the e-mail is not a valid address.

Submit flow: Submit → browser confirmation "Press OK to proceed!" → OK shows the green success banner above the form and replaces the form with a "Home" button; Cancel keeps the form as filled, no banner.
